facts.text: An old friend is a rare thing, John. Eat, rest, and we will see what the High Table has planned.
facts.why: This is not a line from Koji. His real lines on Wikiquote include 'I want you to find your peace. But a good death only comes after a good life.'
facts.fix: A good death only comes after a good life.

fix_note.text: A good death only comes after a good life.

facts.text: Caine raises a glass, blind but never off target.
facts.why: Caine is blind and a dead shot with the pistols at the duel, but no source I read shows him drinking whisky.
facts.fix: Caine at the bar, blind but never off target.
